name: web-search.findings-curate
purpose: Read the findings effectiveness ledger, the dry-run GC report, and open disputes; propose gc, flag, supersede, and dispute-resolution moves with evidence. Report only, no mutation.

include_disputed.description: Include disputed findings in the effectiveness read.

decayed_below.description: Effective confidence under which a finding counts as decayed for proposals.

assumptions: web-search is running and its FindingsService bindings are reachable from the kernel
findings gc with dry_run=true mutates nothing; the binding's declared effect is write because the same RPC can mutate without the flag
the caller executes proposals with the cited CLI verb; this program never executes them
invariants: findings gc is called only with dry_run=true
no flag, supersede, edit, prune, or resolve binding is called
no row set is materialized beyond head(limit); proposals are capped at 12 rows so the envelope fits the 4 KB stdout bound
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
findings/gc (effect write) is called only in act and only with dry_run=True; the program retires nothing

signals.never_surfaced_decayed: never-surfaced rows with effective_confidence below decayed_below
signals.gc_dry_run: counts of {superseded_decayed, cold_archive_candidates, stale_disputes, orphans} from findings gc --dry-run
signals.proposals: at most 12 of {kind, finding_id, verb, evidence}; kind in gc, review-unused, resolve-dispute, supersede-stale; proposal_counts carries the totals
signals.proposal_counts: count per proposal kind over every row read
